title: David and Goliath

questions.question: Who was the Philistine champion?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 17:4 (ESV): “And there came out from the camp of the Philistines a champion named Goliath of Gath...”

questions.question: What reward did Saul offer for killing Goliath?
options: Riches, his daughter, and tax exemption
questions.correctAnswer: Riches, his daughter, and tax exemption
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 17:25 (ESV): “...the king will enrich the man who kills him with great riches and will give him his daughter and make his father’s house free in Israel.”

questions.question: How did David kill Goliath?
options: With a sling and a stone
questions.correctAnswer: With a sling and a stone
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 17:49-50 (ESV): “And David put his hand in his bag and took out a stone and slung it and struck the Philistine on his forehead... So David prevailed... with a sling and with a stone...”

questions.question: What did David take from Goliath after killing him?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 17:51, 54 (ESV): “...Then David ran and stood over the Philistine and took his sword... and cut off his head with it... And David took the head of the Philistine...”

questions.question: Why was David originally at the battle lines?
options: To bring food to his brothers
questions.correctAnswer: To bring food to his brothers
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 17:17-18 (ESV): “And Jesse said to David his son, ‘Take for your brothers an ephah of this parched grain...’”

questions.question: How tall was Goliath?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 17:4 (ESV): "...whose height was six cubits and a span."

questions.question: How many smooth stones did David choose?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 17:40 (ESV): "Then he took his staff in his hand and chose five smooth stones from the brook..."

questions.question: What did Goliath say when he saw David?
options: Am I a dog, that you come to me with sticks?
questions.correctAnswer: Am I a dog, that you come to me with sticks?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 17:43 (ESV): "And the Philistine said to David, 'Am I a dog, that you come to me with sticks?'"

questions.question: Who was David's oldest brother who rebuked him?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 17:28 (ESV): "Now Eliab his eldest brother heard when he spoke... and Eliab's anger was kindled against David..."

questions.question: What did David attempt to wear but took off?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 17:38-39 (ESV): "Then Saul clothed David with his armor... And David said... 'I cannot go with these...' So David put them off."

questions.question: How long did Goliath defy Israel?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 17:16 (ESV): "For forty days the Philistine came forward and took his stand, morning and evening."

questions.question: Where did the battle take place?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 17:2 (ESV): "And Saul and the men of Israel were gathered and encamped in the Valley of Elah..."

questions.question: What animals did David say he had killed guarding sheep?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 17:36 (ESV): "Your servant has struck down both lions and bears..."

questions.question: David said, "The battle is the ______."
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 17:47 (ESV): "...For the battle is the LORD's, and he will give you into our hand."

questions.question: Who was the commander of Saul's army who did not know whose son David was?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 17:55 (ESV): "...Saul said to Abner the commander of the army, 'Abner, whose son is this youth?' And Abner said, 'As your soul lives, O king, I do not know.'"

key_verse_text: Then David said to the Philistine, “You come to me with a sword and with a spear and with a javelin, but I come to you in the name of the LORD of hosts, the God of the armies of Israel, whom you have defied.” (ESV)
